terms.title: Internal reviewer fixture: inspect a payout rail
terms.brief: INTERNAL DEMO, not an independent team campaign. Request a concrete review of an Arc testnet payout flow: identify one authorization risk and write a short, reproducible verification note.
terms.eligibility: Applicants must demonstrate experience reviewing EVM smart contracts and testnet transaction receipts. A specific example of an authorization or replay check is required.
terms.completion: Owner reviews a written verification note with one authorization check and one receipt check. Reviewer fixture evidence is internal and never headline traction.
